first_impression.reaction: Googled 'santorini wedding venues' while I've got three planners open in a spreadsheet. Intro splits the island into areas and says it comes down to guest count, ceremony and view. No 'magical sunsets' fluff, so I kept going. FAQ first, then the table, which says up front it isn't a ranking and admits its blanks. Read the bigger venues, the weather and the legal bit properly. The numbers mostly line up when I check them against each other. Two places where the page says more than its own table supports: the 'none of the 13 is in Fira' line, and Imerovigli being 'all small'.

journey.quote: The right one depends on how many guests you are inviting, the ceremony you want and the view you want behind you as you say your vows.
journey.reaction: Criteria first. Fine. A bit of romance on the end, but I can live with it.

journey.section: Santorini wedding venues at a glance
journey.quote: It is not a ranking. "Not published" means the venue does not state the detail.
journey.reaction: Good. No made-up 'number one', and the gaps are admitted rather than filled in. I trust a table with blanks more than one without.

journey.quote: Canaves lists 25 guests on the Epitome Sunset Terrace, 30 on the Oia Suites Panorama Balcony and 40 on the Sunday Veranda.
journey.reaction: Per-space numbers. That goes straight into the spreadsheet. And it tells me the cliff-edge thing is small before I fall for a photo.

journey.quote: Anything this guide marks "Not published", from capacity to exclusive use, needs an answer in writing before you commit, and your Wedded Advisor confirms inclusions in writing before you sign, through Wedded Concierge.
journey.reaction: Sales link before I've read a single venue. The 'in writing' part is the right message, so it's minor, but the pitch still comes before the proof.

journey.section: Choosing an area of the island
journey.quote: None of the 13 venues here is in Fira or Firostefani, but couples who want guests close to town can still marry nearby: Katikies Chromata is about a five-minute drive from Fira.
journey.reaction: Hang on. Your own table says the area for Venetsanos and Le Ciel is 'Not published'. So how do you know neither is in Fira? Either you know where they are or you don't. That's the page contradicting itself, and it makes me recheck everything else.

journey.quote: Imerovigli holds five venues on this list, all small, from a hotel with a private villa for vows to a resort with 17 rooms.
journey.reaction: 'All small'? Astra and Tholos don't publish capacity, and a few paragraphs up it said 'Five venues sit here, most of them intimate.' Which is it? Small slip, but it's exactly the kind I catch.

journey.quote: Grace requires a wedding planner for every wedding, engaged at least three months before the day, and the wedding party has a private lounge from 8am.
journey.reaction: That's a catch, and it's on the page. Most sites would leave the 'you must hire a planner' rule out. Good.

journey.quote: Guests may book rooms individually, the hotel quotes room blocks or a resort buyout, and no minimum number of rooms is required.
journey.reaction: No minimum room block. That's the sort of term that bites you later, so stating it is useful.

journey.quote: Two wineries face the caldera from inland, each with an open-air terrace for the day.
journey.reaction: Venetsanos is filed under 'Pyrgos and the inland villages' but its area is 'Not published' in the table. Is it inland or not? Same problem as the Fira line.

journey.quote: About 100 seated at round tables, 160 at a standing reception, or 100 theatre style.
journey.reaction: Real numbers for a 100-guest list. One of the few that actually fits us.

journey.quote: The Hellenic National Meteorological Service has no station on Santorini; Naxos is the nearest official station, so read its figures as a guide to the neighbourhood.
journey.reaction: Admits the limitation and still gives me monthly temperatures and rainfall. That's how you do it.

journey.quote: Wildfires occur during the extended summer from June to September, including near tourist areas, and can start with little warning and travel quickly.
journey.reaction: Wildfires and the seismic zone both named, dated and linked to Smartraveller. Wedding sites usually bury this. Points for it.

journey.quote: Which inclusions does a wedding package cover, and which are extra?
journey.reaction: That's my anti-upsell question, written for me. The whole checklist is something I'd actually send.

journey.quote: Plan the legal steps first. As at November 2026, Smartraveller says you may need a Certificate of No Impediment, and a marriage valid in Greece that would also be valid under Australian law is in most cases recognised in Australia.
journey.reaction: Leads with the government source, not a hotel brochure. Right answer to a legal question.

journey.section: Shortlist your Santorini venues with a Wedded Advisor
journey.quote: The fee is agreed in writing before any work begins.
journey.reaction: Right signal. Still doesn't tell me whether any of these venues pay you too.

unanswered_questions: Does Wedded Wonderland take a commission or mark-up from any of these venues, and does that shape which ones the Wedded Advisor recommends?
How is the Wedded Concierge fee worked out and what does it cover?
Where exactly are Venetsanos Winery and Le Ciel, given the table says their area is not published but the page places them?
Is there a real Santorini wedding with the actual budget I can look at?

turn_offs_found.quote: None of the 13 venues here is in Fira or Firostefani, but couples who want guests close to town can still marry nearby: Katikies Chromata is about a five-minute drive from Fira.
turn_offs_found.why: The table lists the area of Venetsanos Winery and Le Ciel as 'Not published', so the page can't then rule out Fira for all 13. It's a claim its own data doesn't support, and once I spot one of those I start doubting the rest.

turn_offs_found.quote: Imerovigli holds five venues on this list, all small, from a hotel with a private villa for vows to a resort with 17 rooms.
turn_offs_found.why: Two of the five don't publish capacity, and the area overview says 'most of them intimate'. 'All small' is a guess dressed as a fact, and it contradicts the page's own wording.

turn_offs_found.quote: Anything this guide marks "Not published", from capacity to exclusive use, needs an answer in writing before you commit, and your Wedded Advisor confirms inclusions in writing before you sign, through Wedded Concierge.
turn_offs_found.why: It lands before any venue is described. The 'in writing' message is the right one, so it's minor, but the pitch still comes before the proof.

would_share_with: My fiancee, the at-a-glance table and the capacity section for a 100-guest list
Both of us, the booking checklist, to send to every venue we shortlist
My dad, the heat, wildfire and earthquake paragraphs and the legal section

cta_reaction.quote: When you are ready, shortlist your Santorini venues through Wedded Concierge.
cta_reaction.why: The page mostly earned it: blanks admitted, per-space numbers, catches named (Grace's mandatory planner, children over 13 only at Katikies), the Naxos weather caveat, dated government advice. What holds me back is the Fira line and 'all small', which are the page overstating its own data, and I still don't know if you take a cut from the venues.

top_3_changes: Fix the Fira claim (must-fix): 'None of the 13 venues here is in Fira or Firostefani' contradicts the table, which lists Venetsanos Winery's and Le Ciel's area as 'Not published'. Either reword to what the page can support (e.g. none of the venues with a published location is in Fira) or confirm the two locations. Check the same issue where Venetsanos sits under 'Pyrgos and the inland villages' and 'Two wineries face the caldera from inland'.
Reconcile Imerovigli: change 'all small' in 'Imerovigli holds five venues on this list, all small' to match 'most of them intimate', since Astra and Tholos don't publish capacity.

Optional: move the primary Wedded Concierge CTA below the first venue section so evidence comes before the pitch. (Commission and fee-model detail would help me most, but that's a deferred business detail, so nice-to-have.)

checks.check: Every journey point and turn-off has an exact quote from the draft
Journey types limited to gained_trust, lost_trust, confused, bored, excited, objection
Stayed in character as Daniel (sceptic): FAQ and table first, cross-checked claims against each other, looked for catches, fee model, commissions
No invented brand facts; fee, commission and real-budget questions placed in unanswered_questions
VERIFY markers and HTML comments ignored
Title, deferred business details and absence of prices not flagged as must-fix; no requests for sourcing or 'how we know' lines

open_questions.question: The Fira line and the placement of Venetsanos under 'Pyrgos and the inland villages' conflict with the table's 'Not published' area for Venetsanos and Le Ciel. Writer reword this round, or does the source pack confirm their locations (in which case the table should be updated)?

assumptions: Daniel arrived via Google for 'santorini wedding venues' while comparing three planners; Santorini is one option among several, hence relevance 4.
No prices on the page is deliberate and not penalised.
Venue wording attributed to the venue (e.g. Andronis's two-Michelin-star description) is not counted as the brand's own unsupported claim.
Title is person-set and deferred, so not flagged.
